description: This file defines the AppDatabase class for the Quick Transfer Android app using Room persistence library. It declares the database entities, DAOs, and provides a singleton instance accessor with thread safety and migration fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class defining the Room database for the app, exposing DAOs for profile, connection, and transfer history, and implementing a singleton pattern for database access.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Abstract method that provides access to profile data operations via ProfileDao.

methods.name: connectionDao
methods.description: Abstract method that provides access to connection data operations via ConnectionDao.

methods.name: transferHistoryDao
methods.description: Abstract method that provides access to transfer history data operations via TransferHistoryDao.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method that returns the singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating it if necessary, with thread-safety and migration fallback.
